versions.sourceCloud: Very reliable — from our cloud library · {size}

versions.ccCommercial: a professional karaoke track: a cover band records the backing, lyrics are on screen, you sing the lead. Sounds like karaoke.
versions.ccCommunity: the original recording, with the lead vocal removed by AI. Sounds like the real song.
versions.ccHint: Most singers pick commercial for classics and community for recent or niche songs.

explainer.communityWhat: The original recording of the song, with the lead vocal removed by AI and karaoke lyrics added by a hobbyist producer.
explainer.communityHow: Like the real song — same instruments, same backing vocals, same energy.
explainer.communityGood: Recent releases, niche songs, and anyone who wants it to sound exactly like the record.
explainer.commercialWhat: A professional karaoke production: a cover band re-records the backing track and a company adds the lyrics.
explainer.commercialHow: Like classic karaoke — a faithful cover, but not the original recording.
explainer.commercialGood: Classics and well-known hits; lyric timing is usually very reliable.
explainer.commercialSummary: For comparison, commercial tracks are covers re-recorded for karaoke — they sound like karaoke.
explainer.communitySummary: For comparison, community tracks use the original song's audio with the vocals removed — they sound like the record.

brands.CC: One of the most prolific community producers — original-recording tracks with AI vocal removal and clean, readable lyrics.
brands.LC: Community producer known for careful lyric timing across a broad rock and alternative catalogue.
brands.FBK: Funbox Karaoke — community producer with wide coverage of modern pop and recent releases.
brands.BELLY: BellySings — community producer using original recordings with AI vocal removal.
brands.NOMAD: Made by Nomad Karaoke — your host's own tracks, built from the original recording with AI vocal separation and hand-reviewed lyrics.
brands.FAKEY: FakeyOke — community producer covering songs the commercial brands never made.
brands.PMK: Punk Media Karaoke — community specialist in punk, emo and alternative tracks.
brands.OBSK: ObsKure Karaoke — community producer focused on obscure and niche songs.
brands.SDK: SNDL Karaoke — high-volume community producer using original recordings.
brands.DBK: Deep Bench Karaoke — community producer with a deep catalogue of lesser-known songs.
brands.KV: Karaoke Version — one of the biggest professional catalogues in the world. Studio-quality cover recordings with reliable lyric timing.
brands.SC: Sound Choice — the legendary US brand many hosts consider the gold standard of professional karaoke.
brands.SBI: SBI Karaoke — major commercial producer with a large international catalogue.
brands.SF: Sunfly — long-running UK commercial brand with decades of chart coverage.
brands.CB: Chart Buster — US commercial brand, especially strong on country music.
brands.ZM: Zoom Entertainments — UK commercial brand with a broad pop catalogue.
brands.VS: Vocal Star — UK commercial karaoke producer.
brands.SK: Sing King — one of the biggest karaoke channels on YouTube; professional cover recordings.
brands.MR: Mr. Entertainer — UK commercial brand with a large budget-friendly catalogue.
brands.PT: Party Tyme Karaoke — US commercial brand with wide chart coverage.
brands.EK: Easy Karaoke — UK commercial karaoke producer.

rules.r1Body: The default order is the order you submit your request. If Jim, Bob, and Jenny each send in a song, they'll sing in that order.
rules.r2Body: First time singing tonight? You'll get bumped up to sing within the next few songs, so everyone gets a chance to perform at least once. The next 2 people in line won't be moved — we respect their spot too.
rules.r3Body: Submit as many songs as you want! We'll spread them out in the rotation so nobody sings twice in a row.
rules.r4Body: Singing with friends? On the confirmation screen before sending your request, tap '👥 Existing singer' to pick someone already on tonight's list, or '+ New singer' to type a name — up to 3 extra people. We'll list everyone on the rotation so the host knows who to call up. Phone numbers for new singers are optional — they just let us text them too when you're close to the front.
rules.r5Body: Let the host know and we'll try to get you one last song before you go. On a busy night when you've already sung 5+ times we may not be able to accommodate — but we'll always try.
rules.r6Body: Want to skip ahead? Tip ${amount}+ and you'll be bumped up to sing very soon. Paid entries are marked with a ♥ on the rotation screen so everyone can see it's fair.
